build_sphinx_documentation: build sphinx HTML documentation from the gRPC Python source directory to a build output directory
build_project_metadata: build a grpcio project metadata module that writes the current version string to a Python file
try_cythonize_extensions: try to cythonize a list of distutils extension modules with optional linetracing support
clean_build_artifacts: clean gRPC Python build artifacts including compiled Cython files, cache directories, and egg-info
gather_dependencies: gather and fetch install or test dependencies for the grpcio project using setuptools build eggs
